text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed an injured Win Variation
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Getting injured like this...
I just wasn't focused enough...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Seriously, it's so pathetic...
choice_data_list: Let's rest up properly and heal that injury.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Please... let me train!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everyone with real talent is training so hard...
If I'm the only one resting, I'll never catch up.
To catch up, I have to do whatever I can...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: All I have... is hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll pay utmost attention to avoid injuries!
...So please!
choice_data_list: Don't rush, let's aim for a full recovery first.
...If I judge that it's even slightly dangerous, I'm putting a stop to it.
...If I judge that it's even slightly dangerous, I'll stop you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll pay utmost attention to avoid injuries!
...So please!
choice_data_list: Don't rush, let's aim for a full recovery first.
...If I judge that it's even slightly dangerous, I'm putting a stop to it.
...If I judge that it's even slightly dangerous, I'll stop you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-But!
While we're doing this, everyone else is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her strong desire to defeat her rivals is driving her impatience. But if her injury worsens, the setback will only be greater.
choice_data_list: It's okay. Even if you rest a little, you can definitely make up for it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...How can you say that with such certainty?
choice_data_list: Because you're an Umamusume who works harder than anyone else.
Because you're an Umamusume who works harder than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll trust your words... and rest for now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll give it a shot, without overdoing it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Guh, uu...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ...To think I couldn't even
judge the severity of my injury...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: What am I doing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation's injury has become even more severe.
She had to spend her time resting until it was fully healed...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...
Alright...!
choice_data_list: A workload like this looks manageable.
A workload like this looks manageable.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no pain or discomfort at all!
...Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'll aim for a full recovery just like this.
Step by step, carefully...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By steadily putting in effort without overdoing it,
Win Variation made a smooth comeback.
